question: Which AnyRouter PR should be the canonical landing path after the registry migration, credential-copy fixes, and live proof are completed?
rationale: This PR and https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2171 implement the same new provider, and repository ownership must select the permanent branch and authorship path.

options.title: Adopt this standalone PR
options.body: Rebase this mergeable branch onto current main, fix the remaining credential UI, preserve original authorship credit, and close the conflicted source PR after proof.

options.title: Restore the source PR
options.body: Move the management-key and macro-registry corrections to the original PR, rebase it, and close this adaptation.

options.title: Defer AnyRouter
options.body: Pause both PRs until maintainers want to support and document management-key access for this provider.

recommendation.title: Adopt this standalone PR
recommendation.body: Rebase this mergeable branch onto current main, fix the remaining credential UI, preserve original authorship credit, and close the conflicted source PR after proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the best available decision owner for provider acceptance and duplicate-PR selection.
